synthesis: Scout's admin "Bird's Eye" org-map briefly shows the "No kits are reporting GPS locations" notice (a dismissible centered card + a persistent bottom amber pill) immediately on page load, then hides it once drivers' GPS positions arrive. This is a mount-order race, not a real empty state: App.vue's `noKitsReporting` computed keys off drivers.length>0, zero real-GPS driverPositions, and scans_today>0 — with NO notion of whether the initial driver-positions fetch has resolved yet. During the window where roster+stats have loaded but the (heavier) positions fetch hasn't, `driverPositions=[]` reads as 'genuinely empty' rather than 'not fetched yet'. Fix: add a `positionsLoaded` flag to the map store that flips true after the first fetchDriverPositions attempt, gate the notice on it, and show a spinner in the meantime.

scope.summary: Add positionsLoaded flag in stores/map.js (flip true after first fetchDriverPositions attempt, success or failure), gate noKitsReporting on it in App.vue so the notice cannot fire before the initial GPS fetch resolves, and render a small spinner (reusing the existing animate-spin inline-SVG convention) during the admin Live-mode initial-load window.

proposed_changes.change: Add `const positionsLoaded = ref(false)` near drivers/driverPositions (~159-160); in fetchDriverPositions() set `positionsLoaded.value = true` after the try/catch, before `return driverPositions.value` (~959); export positionsLoaded in the store return object (~1072).
proposed_changes.reason: Provides a definitive 'initial GPS-positions fetch has resolved' signal that App.vue currently lacks — [] is ambiguous between not-fetched and genuinely-empty.

proposed_changes.change: Add `&& mapStore.positionsLoaded` to the noKitsReporting computed (351-357); add a spinner block gated on `mapStore.adminMode && mapStore.liveMode && !mapStore.positionsLoaded` in the same centered overlay position as the notice card, using the existing animate-spin inline-SVG pattern.
proposed_changes.reason: Closes the race (notice cannot render before the first positions fetch lands) and replaces the flash with a spinner per the ticket ask. Both render sites (card:38, pill:90) share the one computed, so gating the computed fixes both.

questions.q: Should positionsLoaded flip true even if the fetch throws (network error), or only on success?
questions.answer: True even on failure — set it unconditionally after the try/catch, mirroring how fetchDriverPositions already swallows errors and returns current value. Otherwise a transient error leaves the spinner spinning forever.

questions.q: Exact spinner copy and placement — e.g. a 'Loading kits…' label vs. bare spinner, centered card position vs. a corner pill?
questions.answer: Bare centered spinner — the animate-spin inline-SVG centered on the map, no card and no text label.

questions.q: Should the spinner eventually time out and fall back to showing the map plainly if positions never load (persistent backend outage), or spin indefinitely?
questions.answer: No explicit timeout — rely on the first fetchDriverPositions resolving (positionsLoaded flips on success OR caught error) to clear the spinner. No hard timer.

grounding.code_flow: App.vue mounts → useBirdsEyePolling.onMounted (fetchDrivers awaited, THEN Promise.all(fetchDriverPositions, fetchDriverPaths)) races with ScoutHome.onMounted dashboard.fetchAll() (lighter stats). noKitsReporting recomputes on every reactive change and currently renders during the pre-first-positions window. Adding positionsLoaded (set inside fetchDriverPositions, hit by all 3 callers) gives the missing gate.
